subject: Unforeseen field condition: deteriorated existing structure behind the finish wall at

messages.text: We found the deteriorated existing structure behind the finish wall at Placement Zone 2; see General Conditions Article 3 for the assumed condition. Our proposal is to shift the layout locally and hold everything else per plan -- let us know if that works or if you need to review first. This needs a quick turnaround -- please advise as soon as possible. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. This could affect the overall schedule. Please respond this week so we can keep the crew moving.

We'll need photos and measurements of the deteriorated existing structure behind the finish wall at Placement Zone 2 before we can evaluate the workaround. There will be a cost impact to address this condition.
